narrative.text: Jacki Roach contributed to Cypher Defense and TrueSight DAO with four contributions spanning October 2020 to November 2022. These included bringing on an active contributor, validating a user behavior for the Build Game's user experience, participating in a strategy poll vote, and writing an official DAO social media post for marketing.
